title: Pig holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='24' ry='12' fill='#ffb8d4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='10' fill='#ffc2dc' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M33 24 L28 10 L44 18 Z' fill='#ff7fb0'/>
  <path d='M67 24 L72 10 L56 18 Z' fill='#ff7fb0'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <path d='M35 22 L32 14 L42 19 Z' fill='#ffb8d4'/>
  <path d='M65 22 L68 14 L58 19 Z' fill='#ffb8d4'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#4a2c3d'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#4a2c3d'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='34' r='1.3' fill='#ffe6f0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='1.3' fill='#ffe6f0'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ff7fb0'/>
  <ellipse cx='46.5' cy='46' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#c94f80'/>
  <ellipse cx='53.5' cy='46' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#c94f80'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ff6fa8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ff6fa8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='66' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ff9ec4' transform='rotate(-25 34 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='66' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ff9ec4' transform='rotate(25 66 66)'/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 86 C38 76 30 68 32 60 C34 53 44 53 50 61 C56 53 66 53 68 60 C70 68 62 76 50 86 Z' fill='#ff3b5c'/>
  <!-- heart highlight -->
  <path d='M42 60 C40 58 38 62 40 65' stroke='#ff8fa5' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='83' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff7fb0'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='83' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff7fb0'/>
</svg>
